description: This file defines the PolynomialBestFit class, which implements polynomial regression (best-fit) algorithms, including methods for calculating the polynomial equation, slope, and fitting data points. It extends a base class BestFit and interacts with external classes like Matrix for mathematical operations.

classes.name: PolynomialBestFit
classes.description: A class for performing polynomial best-fit regression on data points, including computing the polynomial coefficients, equation, slope, and goodness of fit.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Returns the order (degree) of the polynomial regression.

methods.name: getValueOfYForX
methods.description: Calculates the Y value for a given X based on the polynomial regression.

methods.name: getValueOfXForY
methods.description: Calculates the X value for a given Y based on the regression.

methods.name: getEquation
methods.description: Returns a string representing the polynomial equation of the best fit.

methods.name: getSlope
methods.description: Returns the slope coefficients of the polynomial; optionally rounded to specified decimal places.

methods.name: getCoefficients
methods.description: Returns all coefficients of the polynomial, including intercept, optionally rounded.

methods.name: polynomialRegression
methods.description: Performs the polynomial regression calculation over provided data points.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a PolynomialBestFit object, performing the regression if no errors occur.
